headline: Farantouris Responds to Marinakis on Non-Performing Loans: PASOK's Proposal Is Compliant with European Law
summary: PASOK MEP Nikolaos Farantouris said his party's proposals on non-performing loans comply with European law. He was responding to government spokesperson Pavlos Marinakis.
why: Non-performing loans affect bank balance sheets, lending capacity and credit risk in the Greek banking system. Rules governing their treatment are shaped by EU law.
